sub_site: blood (baseline, advanced NSCLC patients on ICIs)

evidence.quote: T0 blood microbiome analyses were available for 42 patients of cohort #1
The microbiome of blood samples was analyzed by sequencing the V3–4 regions of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene at time point T0
The number of 16S rRNA gene copies was quantified by comparing with a standard curve derived from serial dilutions of plasmid standards

notes: Blood 16S (Vaiomer) with 16S qPCR load; only 16S copy number results reported (responders lower). No taxa reported in text, tables or figures despite LEfSe in methods; no supplements available. 'Control samples' mentioned once (E0085) without description - not clearly negative controls, coded none_mentioned. Main focus is plasma citrulline.
